reuse.why: Adds the rule to the existing getMonthWideCategories selection and moves setZero onto it, but copyPreviousMonth keeps its own filter chain and goal-template adds its own fixed filter instead of sharing a selection.

duplication.why: The 'skip fixed' check is re-applied in three filters (getMonthWideCategories, copyPreviousMonth, computeTemplates) next to the duplicated income/templated checks, though setZero's copy was removed.

placement.why: The tag lookup lives in budget/actions.ts beside getCategoriesWithTemplates; goal-template importing it from actions follows the existing import direction.

scope.why: Focused on the rule; the setZero consolidation is a small related cleanup.

maintainability.why: One named, documented predicate decides the tag; a further skip rule would still need to be added in three filters.

bypasses_abstraction.where: budget/actions.ts copyPreviousMonth still filters categories itself (income, hidden, templated, now fixed) instead of using getMonthWideCategories

one_place.where: the #fixed test is defined once in getFixedGroupCategoryIds (actions.ts) and every month-wide path uses it, although it is applied in three separate filters (getMonthWideCategories, copyPreviousMonth, goal-template computeTemplates)
